query: I was walking around the old town this morning and found the cutest little bakery that sells lavender honey croissants, they’re still warm when you pick them up and the filling oozes out just right when you take a bite. I even bought a small jar of their homemade jam to bring back home for my mom, she’s been obsessed with fruit preserves ever since she started her little garden last summer. Oh, and I also met a street artist who drew a little caricature of my dog that’s so spot on it had me laughing for five whole minutes. Anyway, I’m having a bit of an issue with my phone right now—my data usage has gone over the limit, I’m currently abroad and I have roaming turned off, so my mobile data isn’t working at all and I need help figuring out what to do.
